excerpt.zh:
我们已对L-星门有了足够的认知，可以开始研究其背后的科技。研究完成之后，我们应该可以派一艘科研船来中断其无限维护循环。

L-星团已经触手可及了！
excerpt.en:
We have now gathered sufficient L-Gate insights to research the technology behind them. Once this has been done, one of our Science Ships should be able to abort the perpetual maintenance cycle they are stuck in.

The L-Cluster is almost within our reach!

texts.zh: [From.GetName]已经收集齐所有解锁L-星门网络的必要认知！一旦他们研究了L-星门科技并完成一项特殊任务来开启他们境内的L-星门，他们将可抵达L-星团。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] has gathered all the insights necessary to unlock the L-Gate Network! Once they have researched the L-Gate technology and finished a special project to open an L-Gate within their borders, they will have access to the L-Cluster.
